scope: Bounded offline correctness/source review of supported GitHub Git-data publication transport
source_version_distinction: The byte-exact historical executed version is preserved separately. The current project source includes a later receipt-preservation correction and was tested offline; this review does not relabel historical live execution as a run of the revised source.

fixed_finding.original_behavior: Default offline inspection checkpointed a fresh report over the per-commit publication receipt and its verified-object cache.
fixed_finding.current_behavior: Offline inspection returns before any receipt mutation; an existing publication receipt requires --resume; completed matching receipts are preserved and only remote HEAD is checked.

transport_review.supported_service_api: GitHub Git database API through installed gh CLI
transport_review.credentials: Normal inherited gh authentication; source does not read credential values or start a login
transport_review.proxy_and_tls: Subprocess inherits normal environment; no direct egress/proxy replacement/TLS-ignore mechanism in reviewed source
transport_review.immutable_identity_checks: Returned blob, tree and commit IDs must equal reviewed local Git IDs before branch update
transport_review.branch_update: Explicit force:false plus before-upload and before-ref base checks
transport_review.ambiguous_ref_failure: main_ref_write_attempted is persisted before PATCH; ref_updated requires a matching API response; a timeout may mean the remote changed, and receipt/status requires reinspection
transport_review.resume: Only cached IDs belonging to the exact inspected commit/tree are accepted; normal cache rows originate after returned blob-ID verification; final tree/commit/ref checks still run
transport_review.receipt_durability_limit: Active publication checkpoints use ordinary local file writes, not a crash-safe transaction. A corrupted interrupted cache stops resume rather than authorizing a ref update; inspect remote state after ambiguous writes.

live_deployment_evidence: Historical owner receipts and README report Pages Action40048661028 and58live route checks. This reviewer made no new live request and does not independently reassert current remote availability.
